title: Peat on the moors, cattle in the badlands
changes: The Beacon Cairn now stands north of Cairnwatch's gate, its peat fire burning bright after dusk. Cairnwatch's halls have turf roofs and peat smoke, with peat stacks and cut banks round them and way-cairns along the Moors Highway.
A mine headframe with its winch stands over the shaft at the Cinnabar Pits, with ore carts beside it. You can't walk through it or the Beacon Cairn.
The Rustwater Post is a drovers' town now: bleached plank houses with hides and longhorn skulls, longhorns and a trough in the pen, and more of the herd grazing outside.
Cairnwatch's and Rustwater's captains, healers and armourers have new things to say about peat, barrows, mines and cattle.
